triggering_merge_pr.author: mitchdenny

candidate_merges.message: Set local socket directory and endpoint permissions consistently (#20330) ## Description Use a shared helper to set directory permissions before binding backchannel, DCP, and terminal sockets, and endpoint permissions before listening. Configure the Hex1b PTY socket directory through its existing environment variable. Adds platform-specific coverage and documentation. Windows runtime validation and replacing the Hex1b environment-variable workaround remain follow-ups. Fixes # (issue) ## Checklis

This matches a known recurring flaky test with the same test name, job, and error pattern, unrelated to the merged socket-permissions PR.
